messages:
maya: Heads-up — Spectra procurement uploaded a SIG + asked explicitly for EU-only data residency and BYOK for KMS. They need answers by Wed AM to avoid procurement delay.
sec_bot: Intake created: INT-SPECTRA-2026-71. Priority: high. SLA 48h.
raj: Can someone from security confirm BYOK flow? If they keep keys in their AWS account we need cross-account role + CloudTrail evidence.
toni: We support BYOK for object store/embeddings. Requirements: 1) customer KMS ARN, 2) cross-account IAM role with kms:Encrypt/decrypt permissions, 3) logging to customer's CloudTrail or shared logging bucket.
leah: Legal: If keys remain in customer's account, check DPA for key escrow clauses; may need addendum. Also ask if Spectra is subject to GDPR special processing clauses.
maya: POC will run in eu-central-1 and exercise embeddings + vector search. I've uploaded the SIG to the intake portal and linked the contract excerpt. Link: https://files.redwood/spectra/sig
raj: I'll draft the CAIQ top-10 answers focused on key mgmt, tenant isolation, and logging and post them here within 24h.
toni: Sample IAM snippet for cross-account access (short):
```
{ "Version":"2012-10-17", "Statement":[{ "Effect":"Allow", "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:888888888888:key/spectra-cmk" }]}
```
leah: FYI finance: an EU-dedicated for tenant partitioning will be ~+20% list. If they opt Private (on-prem) tell sales it’s a separate quote.
maya: Thanks — please mark INT-SPECTRA-2026-71 high-priority. We need a one-pager security summary + CAIQ answers by Tue EOD to hand to procurement.
sec_bot: INT-SPECTRA-2026-71 status: triage -> in_progress at 1720001800 by raj
raj: Uploaded CAIQ top-10 and 1-page security summary to intake. Mentioned BYOK pattern and attached example key-policy.
leah: Shared SOC2 and pen test summary via secure upload.
maya: Customer confirmed POC greenlit pending BYOK confirmation. Closing this thread once KMS guide is posted.
sec_bot: INT-SPECTRA-2026-71 status: in_progress -> resolved_by_raj at 1720003600
